name: fatfish-watermark
description: Replace electerm's default terminal watermark with the original 大肥鱼 (DeepSeek whale-girl) sprite, or its 8-colour pixel version.
author: ZHAO Xudong

electerm.name: Fatfish Terminal Watermark
electerm.description: Replace the default electerm watermark with the original 大肥鱼 / DeepSeek whale-girl sprite, or its 8-colour pixel version.

configs.name: style
configs.label: Artwork style
configs.description: Original PNG is the untouched MIT sprite (default); Colour pixel art is the same character reduced to an 8-colour pixel grid.

configs.name: opacity
configs.label: Opacity (%)
configs.description: How strong the watermark is, in percent. Clamped to 5–60; the sprite is drawn at 1.4x this value, which matches the visual weight of the old wordmark.

configs.name: size
configs.label: Height (%)
configs.description: Watermark height as a percent of the terminal pane. Clamped to 30–95; the width follows the artwork's aspect ratio.

configs.name: autoRun
configs.label: Apply on launch
configs.description: Re-apply on every launch. This is the switch that puts the widget in electerm's auto-run list.

zh_cn.name: 大肥鱼终端水印
zh_cn.description: 把 electerm 默认终端水印替换为原版大肥鱼 / DeepSeek 鲸鱼少女形象，或它的 8 色像素版本。

style.label: 图案风格
style.description: 原版 PNG 是未经修改的 MIT 素材（默认）；彩色像素画是同一角色的 8 色像素版本。

opacity.label: 不透明度（%）
opacity.description: 水印强度，单位为百分比。限制在 5–60；实际绘制时按该值的 1.4 倍，以匹配旧版文字水印的视觉权重。

size.label: 高度（%）
size.description: 水印高度占终端面板的百分比。限制在 30–95；宽度按图案比例自动计算。

autoRun.label: 启动时生效
autoRun.description: 每次启动都重新应用。这个开关会把 widget 加入 electerm 的自动运行列表。
